title: From Toys To Tools: Bambu Lab’s Third Gen 3D Printer Makes Multi-Material Manufacturing Just Work
summary: Bambu Lab releases its third generation 3D printer, a desktop machine capable of multi-material 3D printing at the touch of a button.
